text.en:
Scoring <pve 2 /> <pvp [1] /> kills grants 'Red Death Charged'.

Your next kill with Red Death Reformed consumes this buff and triggers a burst of healing, granting 120 HP (<solar/>Cure x2) to allies within a 7.5 meter radius of you.

This kill also spawns a <solar/>Restoration Orb at your feet, granting you and allies <solar/>Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with <solar/>Ember of Solace) on pickup.
